text: English | Русский | O'zbekcha A high-performance Golang CLI utility and local API proxy server that enables any application or coding agent to connect to DeepSeek V3 ( deepseek-chat ) and R1 ( deepseek-reasoner / Thinking) models via a free web account ( chat.deepseek.com ), without requiring an official paid DeepSeek API key. Rewritten from scratch in pure Go (Golang) based on in-depth analysis of Node.js ( FreeDeepseekAPI-EN ) and Python ( deepseek_bridge ) projects, featuring zero runtime dependencies . Requires Go 1.20+: # Clone repository and navigate to directory: git clone https://github.com/xamrayev/nexus-cli.git cd nexus-cli # Build the executable binary: go build -o bin/nexus . # Install globally to system PATH (optional): go install . 🔑 Authentication (Account Linking) There are 3 ways to connect your DeepSeek account: ./bin/nexus auth login You will be prompted for your userToken : ./bin/nexus auth chrome This automatically launches a Chrome window. Once you log in, Nexus securely captures and stores the session token. Create a .env file in the project root: DEEPSEEK_TOKEN = your_deepseek_token_here 💡 Usage Examples 1. Interactive Chat (REPL) ./bin/nexus chat Or simply: ./bin/nexus Real-time R1 reasoning stream: nexus ❯ Why is the sky blue? 💭 Thinking Process: The user is asking about the physical cause behind the color of the sky... Need to explain the mechanism of Rayleigh scattering of sunlight by atmospheric molecules... 🤖 DeepSeek (deepseek-reasoner): The primary reason the sky appears blue is due to a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering... 2. One-off prompt ./bin/nexus " Provide 3 key facts about general relativity " 3. Code analysis via Unix Pipe cat main.go | ./bin/nexus " Analyze this code for security vulnerabilities and performance bottlenecks " 4. Running the Local API Proxy Server ./bin/nexus serve --port 9655 You can now route any tool (Cursor, Open WebUI, Claude Code) to http://localhost:9655/v1 ! Sample cURL request in OpenAI format: curl http://localhost:9655/v1/chat/completions \ -H " Content-Type: application/json " \ -d ' { "model": "deepseek-reasoner", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}], "stream": true } ' 5. Native Ollama API Emulation 🦙 Nexus implements the Ollama API specification. Open WebUI, Dify, AnythingLLM, Cursor, LlamaIndex, and official Ollama libraries can connect directly to http://localhost:9655 : # 1. Fetch available models (Ollama format) curl http://localhost:9655/api/tags # 2. Ollama Chat request (NDJSON streaming) curl http://localhost:9655/api/chat -d ' { "model": "deepseek-reasoner", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}], "stream": true } ' Using the official Python Ollama SDK: import ollama client = ollama . Client ( host = "http://localhost:9655" ) resp = client . chat ( model = "deepseek-reasoner" , messages = [ { "role" : "user" , "content" : "Write a simple HTTP server in Go" } ]) print ( resp [ "message" ][ "content" ]) 6. Structured Outputs & JSON Schema 🎯 Enforce strict JSON output or conform to a specified schema: # 1. Direct JSON from CLI (pipeable to jq) ./bin/nexus " Top 3 programming languages and their primary domains " --format json | jq . # 2. Via Ollama API: curl http://localhost:9655/api/chat -d ' { "model": "deepseek-reasoner", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "List 3 fruits in JSON"}], "format": "json", "stream": false } ' # 3. Via OpenAI API (response_format): curl http://localhost:9655/v1/chat/completions -d ' { "model": "deepseek-reasoner", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Return device specs as JSON"}], "response_format": {"type": "json_object"} } ' 7. Universal Integrations (Launcher) 🚀 Launch coding tools and agents with a single command — Nexus automatically boots the proxy server in the background: # 1. Claude Code CLI (powered by DeepSeek R1 / V3) ./bin/nexus launch claude ./bin/nexus launch claude -p " Refactor this Go code " # 2. Official DeepSeek Harness CLI (@deepseek-ai/dsh) ./bin/nexus launch dsh # 3. OpenAI Codex CLI (auto-configured with responses wire API) ./bin/nexus launch codex # 4. OpenCode CLI (with automated config injection) ./bin/nexus launch opencode # 5. Block Goose AI Agent (via OpenAI provider) ./bin/nexus launch goose # 6. Aider Pair Programming CLI (with DeepSeek R1) ./bin/nexus launch aider # 7. ChatGPT Desktop (macOS) & local bridge ./bin/nexus launch chatgpt # 8. Multi-Account Pool Monitor ./bin/nexus launch pool # 9. DeepSeek Agentic Eval & Benchmark Harness ./bin/nexus launch harness 8. Multi-Account Pool 👥 Avoid rate limits (HTTP 429) by cycling through multiple DeepSeek accounts using Round-Robin rotation: # Add a new account ./bin/nexus auth add acc2 --chrome # List accounts and check their status ./bin/nexus auth list # Switch active account ./bin/nexus auth switch acc2 # Validate all accounts in the pool ./bin/nexus auth test 9. System Diagnostics (Doctor) ./bin/nexus doctor 📁 Project Structure nexus-cli/ ├── bin/ │ └── nexus # Compiled binary executable ├── cmd/ │ └── nexus/main.go # CLI command dispatcher ├── pkg/ │ ├── deepseek/ │ │ ├── pow.go # Pure Go parallel DeepSeekHashV1 Keccak PoW solver │ │ ├── pow_test.go # PoW test suite & benchmarks │ │ ├── stream.go # SSE JSON patch & OpenAI stream parser │ │ ├── stream_test.go # Stream tests │ │ ├── auth.go # Token, session, and profile manager │ │ ├── chrome_auth.go # Automated Chrome CDP authentication │ │ ├── client.go # DeepSeek Web API client (Chat, Sessions, Auto-retry) │ │ └── types.go # Model configs and type definitions │ ├── server/ │ │ ├── server.go # Local HTTP proxy server (Routing, CORS, Auth) │ │ ├── server_test.go # Server endpoint unit tests │ │ ├── openai.go # OpenAI Chat Completions API adapter │ │ ├── anthropic.go # Anthropic Messages API adapter (for Claude Code) │ │ └── session.go # Agent session isolation and cleanup │ ├── launcher/ │ │ └── launcher.go # Launchers for Claude Code, Codex, Goose, Aider, etc. │ └── cli/ │ ├── terminal.go # ANSI styling, banners, and spinners │ ├── repl.go # Interactive terminal chat & slash commands │ ├── runner.go # Single-prompt and Unix pipe runner │ └── doctor.go # End-to-end system diagnostics ├── main.go # Application entry point ├── go.mod # Go module definition ├── README.md # Main documentation (English) ├── README.ru.md # Russian documentation (Русский) └── README.uz.md # Uzbek documentation (O'zbekcha) 📄 License Distributed under the MIT License.
